resources.string: Connect a gamepad or keyboard, then open this screen again.

Changes save for this device only. Bind a button, or move a stick to see its Android axis name. Select the axis for each role below. Menu mode moves a cursor; use Select / F12 to enable game controls.
Press and release the button on the selected device. Back cancels.

The report mentions a graphics error. Required OpenGL ES or robust-access support may be unavailable, or a shader/driver operation failed. Lower resolution can help memory pressure but cannot add missing driver features. Copy the report for diagnosis.
The report indicates a possible memory shortage. Close other games, choose a lower resolution and reduce bots in the game. Copy the report if it happens again.
There is not enough free storage. Free some space, then prepare / verify the game files in the launcher.
The native runtime or its matching game cache could not load. Use the official APK for the supported ABI and prepare / verify the game files. Copy the report if it persists.
The session ended unexpectedly. The cause is not yet known. Copy the report and include the device model and the stage where it stopped. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
